passages.title: Notice: office move
passages.body:
NOTICE TO STAFF

On Friday, May 17, the Accounting and Payroll departments will move from the third floor to the newly renovated sixth floor. The move will take place after business hours, and movers will transport all desks, files and equipment. Employees are asked to pack personal items in the boxes provided by Facilities and to label each box with their name and new desk number. Please remove all items from the tops of desks by 5 p.m.

The sixth floor offers a larger kitchen, two additional meeting rooms and a quiet room for phone calls. Employees should report to the sixth floor on Monday, May 20. Questions may be directed to Facilities at extension 410.

passages.title: Email: request for a quotation
passages.body:
To: sales@brightprint.example
From: Hana Watanabe <hana.watanabe@orchardtravel.example>
Date: February 8
Subject: Quotation for brochures

Dear Sir or Madam,

Orchard Travel is preparing a new range of brochures for the summer season and would like a quotation for 5,000 full-color copies. Each brochure would have twelve pages and be printed on 120-gram glossy paper. We would need delivery to our head office in Leeds no later than March 28. Could you also tell us whether you offer a discount for orders above 3,000 copies and what your payment terms are? We have used another printer in the past, but we were not satisfied with the delivery times.

I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
Hana Watanabe
Marketing Manager, Orchard Travel

passages.title: Text-message chain
passages.body:
Marco Silva (9:12 A.M.)
I'm stuck on the highway. There's been an accident near exit 14.

Lena Berg (9:14 A.M.)
How long do you think you'll be delayed? The client presentation starts at ten.

Marco Silva (9:15 A.M.)
Probably thirty minutes. Could you start with the introduction slides?

Lena Berg (9:17 A.M.)
Sure. But the client wants to see the budget figures, and those are on your laptop.

Marco Silva (9:18 A.M.)
I'll email them to you right now. They're in the file named Q3_Budget.

Lena Berg (9:20 A.M.)
Got it. Drive safely!

passages.title: Job posting
passages.body:
JOB OPENING: CUSTOMER SERVICE COORDINATOR

Lakeside Hotels, one of the region's leading hospitality groups, is seeking a Customer Service Coordinator to join its Reservations Center in Madison. [1] The successful candidate will respond to guest inquiries by phone and e-mail, resolve booking problems and train new team members. [2] Applicants must have at least two years of customer service experience and strong communication skills. Knowledge of Spanish is an advantage but not required. [3]

We offer a competitive salary, paid vacation and free meals at our hotels. [4] Interested applicants should send a résumé and cover letter to jobs@lakesidehotels.example by June 15.

passages.title: Article: museum reopening
passages.body:
CITY MUSEUM TO REOPEN AFTER EXPANSION

The Harbor City Museum will reopen to the public on September 3 after a two-year expansion project. The new wing adds 2,000 square meters of gallery space and a rooftop café overlooking the river. Director Elaine Foster said the expansion was funded mainly by private donations. "Visitors will find more interactive exhibits than ever before," she said.

To celebrate the reopening, admission will be free during the first weekend. After that, tickets will cost twelve dollars for adults and six dollars for students. Guided tours in English, French and Spanish will be offered daily at 11 a.m. and 3 p.m. The museum will be open from Tuesday to Sunday.

passages.title: Web page: evening classes
passages.body:
RIVERSIDE COMMUNITY COLLEGE — EVENING CLASSES

Expand your skills this autumn with our evening courses, designed for working adults.

Introduction to Bookkeeping — Mondays, 6:30–8:30 P.M. — 8 weeks — $180
Business Writing — Wednesdays, 7:00–9:00 P.M. — 6 weeks — $150
Spreadsheet Skills — Thursdays, 6:00–8:00 P.M. — 4 weeks — $120

Registration opens August 1 and closes one week before each course begins. Students who register for two or more courses receive a 10 percent discount on the total. Course materials are included in the fee. Classes are held in the Wilson Building, and free parking is available behind the building.

passages.title: Letter: change of schedule
passages.body:
Dear Ms. Ibrahim,

I am writing to confirm the details of your visit to our Rotterdam plant on October 22. Because of a scheduling conflict, the factory tour will begin at 9:30 A.M. instead of 10:00 A.M. Please bring a photo ID and sign in at the security desk. Closed-toe shoes are required in the production area, and safety glasses will be provided.

Following the tour, our director of operations, Mr. De Vries, will join you for lunch in the executive dining room. He would like to discuss the proposed delivery schedule for next year. If you have any dietary restrictions, please let my office know by October 15.

Sincerely,
Jonas Pieters
Plant Manager

passages.title: Library announcement
passages.body:
OAKDALE PUBLIC LIBRARY — NEW SERVICES

Starting on January 5, library cardholders will be able to borrow e-books and audiobooks through the library's new mobile app. The app is free and can be downloaded from major app stores. Users can borrow up to five digital items at a time for 21 days. Items return automatically, so there are no late fees.

In addition, the library will extend its Saturday hours. Beginning January 5, the main branch will stay open until 8 P.M. instead of 5 P.M. Children's story time will continue every Saturday at 10 A.M. For more information, please ask at the front desk or visit the library's website.

passages.title: Online review
passages.body:
★★★★☆  Great food, slow service
Posted by Daniel K. on May 2

I took my team to Casa Verde for a farewell lunch and was very impressed by the food. The grilled fish was perfectly cooked, and the vegetarian options were creative. However, we waited nearly twenty minutes to be seated even though we had a reservation, and our server seemed overwhelmed. To its credit, the manager apologized and offered us free desserts, which was a nice gesture.

Prices are reasonable for the quality, and the private room is perfect for groups of ten or more. I would return, but I would recommend arriving early if you are in a hurry.

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the notice?
choices: To describe a new software system
To inform employees about a relocation

fr.rule: L'objet apparaît dans la première phrase : le déménagement de deux services.
fr.example: To inform employees about a relocation

en.rule: The purpose is in the first sentence: two departments are moving.
why_wrong: B: no new hire is mentioned.
en.example: To inform employees about a relocation

questions.stem: In which position marked [1], [2], [3] or [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Candidates who speak a second language are encouraged to apply."

C: before the duties are described, the sentence has no context.
